comment: Rival marks on the held board after a real podium story (#536): a joined human plays five rule bots on Larak Lot, the first match with ordinary aim and trigger input and the second standing open, short frag limits, two matches in a row on one server process. The server's session head-to-head book (podium.story) names the nemesis and the fighters the human leads or trails; the board keeps that book into the next match. Run with FRAGR_QA_MAP=1 FRAGR_QA_MODE=ffa FRAGR_QA_BOTS=5 FRAGR_QA_FRAG_LIMIT=8 FRAGR_QA_SEED=42 FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/scoreboard-rivals.json.

states.name: rivals_first_match
states.note: The first match played out: the podium story arrives with the result.

states.name: rivals_podium_board
states.note: The board held on the podium: nemesis and the up, down or level book beside each rival.

states.name: rivals_second_match_board
states.note: The next match on the same server: the book is kept for the session and marks the held board mid-round, on pad glyphs.

states.name: rivals_second_podium_board
states.note: The second podium: the book grown over two matches, and a rival who now leads the viewer named nemesis.
